name: H9 : ORIGIN
source:
Set in the late-1990s development studio of the never-released “Tokimeki Strip Rock-Paper-Scissors,” this faux-documentary horror adventure (ADV) draws you into the mystery behind a long-buried incident.

[From Steam]
